The '''Mk VIII Safety Shield''' was a [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|device]] used to create a [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]]. It was created by [[Keizar-Volvec/Legends|Keizar-Volvec]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
